by
  intro x
  rw [pow_le_pow_iff (le_rfl (p / |t|) ^ p) (le_rfl (p / |t|) ^ p)]
  apply le_trans
  apply (Real.exp_le_cosh_add_mul_sinh ht)
  apply (Real.exp_le_cosh_add_mul_sinh (Real.neg ht))
  have h1 : Real.exp (t * x) + Real.exp (-t * x) ≤ 2 * max (Real.exp (t * x)) (Real.exp (-t * x)) := by
    rw [Real.max_eq]
    split
    · exact le_refl _
    · exact le_refl _
  rw [Real.max_eq] at h1
  have h2 : (Real.exp (t * x) + Real.exp (-t * x)) / 2 ≤ max (Real.exp (t * x)) (Real.exp (-t * x)) :=
    div_le_of_le_mul (le_one (Real.exp (t * x)) (le_exp_zero_one _)) (le_one (Real.exp (-t * x)) (le_exp_zero_one _))
  rw [Real.max_eq] at h2
  have h3 : (Real.exp (t * x) + Real.exp (-t * x)) / 2 ≤ max (Real.exp (t * x)) (Real.exp (-t * x)) :=
    h2
  have h4 : max (Real.exp (t * x)) (Real.exp (-t * x)) = Real.cosh (t * x) := by
    rw [Real.cosh_def]
    rw [Real.max_eq]
    split
    · exact le_refl _
    · exact le_refl _
  rw [h4]
  have h5 : Real.cosh (t * x) ≤ (p / |t|) ^ p * Real.cosh (t * x) :=
    mul_le_mul_right (le_one (Real.cosh (t * x)) (le_cosh_one _)) (le_rfl (p / |t|) ^ p)
  rw [h5]
  have h6 : Real.cosh (t * x) ≤ (p / |t|) ^ p * Real.cosh (t * x) :=
    h5
  rw [h6]
  exact le_rfl
